title: Board Count Check
short_answer: Reconcile takeoff, receiving, and on-floor stacks before hang — shortages mid-hang stop the crew.
summary: We do not guess board count in a stairwell.
plain_words: We do not guess board count in a stairwell. The handoff should already carry it. Your job is to notice when reality is wildly off (wrong product, wrong floor, obvious short) and report actual vs packet back to the office — that is how estimating gets better. You do not rewrite Monday money columns from Job Check.
when_to_use: Before stocking rooms or starting hang
When packs look short vs the PO
prerequisites: Read drawings and finish schedule before acting
